purpose: Semantic-risk checklist for requested10–20%prose compression. No TeX edits. Mechanical retention alone does not certify meaning preservation.

items.text_anchor: The structural guarantees of the exact DC representation
items.must_retain: Exact convexity/monotonicity concern paired sign-separated inputs. Reconstructing predictions after numerical stabilization does not establish that each transformed stream remains convex/monotone. Streams do not certify unique human-interpretable concepts.

items.must_retain: Stopping-game recovery uses signed discounted occupations. Full alpha-beta LRP recovery is at the routing-game unit-temperature anchor under stated propagation conventions. Player signs, routing probabilities and trajectory weights have distinct roles.

items.must_retain: SplitCAM uses local split activation times shifted sensitivity channel sums; combined g/h use reconstructed activation and balanced sensitivity differences. No positive-gradient clipping or outer ReLU. Alpha=0 gives raw sensitivities; alpha=1/2 collapses to original-gradient multiples.

items.text_anchor: The propagation is initialized at the class-specific positive output
items.must_retain: SplitLRP jointly propagates both streams, initialized at positive g output, with gamma=0, epsilon=1e-6, transparent paired Maxout gates, and stated pooling/normalization conventions. Conservation is only up to epsilon.
items.compression_risk: Generic LRP-on-two-networks wording loses the implemented rule.

items.text_anchor: The first affine layer of an
items.must_retain: An ICNN first affine layer may be unconstrained: convexity does not imply nonnegative raw-input gradients. For f(x)=g(x)-h(1-x), grad f=grad g+(grad h)(1-x); one stream can outweigh the other. Positive full gradient gives only sufficiently small feasible coordinate improvement at differentiable inputs, not necessary features, class change or finite counterfactuals. Finite claims require full-model interventions.
items.compression_risk: Removing these contrasts restores a refuted mathematical overclaim.

Do not claim these directly test every pretrained decomposition. items.text_anchor: with any finite list of blocks, including the empty list
items.must_retain: Transformer theorem covers all finite depths including zero, nonempty fixed allowed-key sets, positive LayerNorm epsilon, supported activations and signed affine readout. Compiled heads are convex/monotone/nonnegative on independent nonnegative doubled inputs; raw-input pullbacks are globally convex/nonnegative but generally not monotone.

items.text_anchor: The real-arithmetic proof supplies no floating-point error bound
items.must_retain: Full-input-dependent exact DC supplies no floating-point stability, runtime or attribution-quality guarantee. Diagnostic is post-normalization, unlike the formal pre-normalization architecture. Preserve 15/20 cases above1e-8 and stream magnitudes5.95e111. Thesis ViT attribution results evaluate conditioned routing, not this new convex construction.

Reported ViT numbers use composite merged AV with alpha/beta once per block; sequential alternative was not used. DAVE rows identify this extra-mean-detached implementation.

items.must_retain: Zero-denominator nonnegative-contribution ratios are zero. A zero-mass state sends probability one to the cemetery, not an unnormalized all-zero successor law. items.text_anchor: normalized signed measure on complete neuron walks
items.must_retain: NRM relevance may be signed despite totalone; game law is nonnegative with separate signs/discounts.
